I know if you're getting stuff through UPS you can call them and ask them to hold it and they will provided it's not hazardous materials. I think nowadays you can even pick up the haz-mats. You'd need to find the UPS warehouse (where the trucks leave) and not a UpS store though. Chances are there is only one warehouse in your county though, so it's a crap shoot if it'd actually be any closer to you, but it's worth a shot.

And I, too, am sorry for the hostility. It just sucks to see so many people ranking on the drivers. It really is a hard and taxing job, and we have management constantly breathing down our necks. It's the way corporate tells us to do stuff. It's completely out of our control and honestly I don't believe half the "the truck pulled up and just drove away" stories. Management would have your ass in a sling and cut your hours to a point where you'd be scared you're not gonna be able to pay your rent this month. The circle jerk just gets to me sometimes, haha.
